scripts.reset:hard: rm -rf node_modules artifacts/kidschedule/node_modules artifacts/amynest-splash/node_modules && node scripts/clean-vite-cache.mjs --dist && pnpm install
scripts.dev:mobile: node -e "console.error('Expo app archived at archive/amynest-mobile-expo. Use: pnpm dev:web + artifacts/amynest-capacitor (iOS/Android).'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.build: pnpm run check:static-audio && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:web: pnpm run check:static-audio && BASE_PATH=/ PORT=3000 pnpm --filter @workspace/kidschedule build
scripts.generate:static-audio:audio-lessons: pnpm run scan:speakable-phrases && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run generate-static-audio -- --audio-lessons-only
scripts.generate:static-audio:study-zone: pnpm run scan:speakable-phrases && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run generate-static-audio -- --study-zone-only
scripts.generate:static-audio:parent-hub: pnpm run scan:speakable-phrases && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run generate-static-audio -- --parent-hub-only
scripts.check:amy-voice: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-amy-voice-usage && pnpm --filter @workspace/kidschedule exec vitest run src/lib/amy-speech-mode.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-intent.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-emotion.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-teacher.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-learning.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-health.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-golden.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-field-validation.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-cohorts.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-experiments.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-struggle-insights.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-delivery-profile.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-invariants.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-governance.test.ts src/lib/amy-voice-personality.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.codegen: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && pnpm run typecheck:libs
